description: SNOTEL-fed resorts ranked by snowpack relative to normal: snow water equivalent against the station's own 1991–2020 median for today's date, deepest first, optionally within one state. Only measured station readings qualify, inside the 10–300 % band and above 2 in of SWE; early-season noise is withheld, not ranked. Same data as https://www.peakcam.io/snow-report/percent-of-normal.

state.description: US state or Canadian province code (`CO`, `UT`, `BC`), or for the Andes the country name PeakCam lists (`Chile`, `Argentina`). Case-insensitive.

name: get_percent_of_normal

asOf.description: ISO instant of the newest report the ranking used.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant the result was generated.

phase.description: `pre-season`/`early`: nothing rankable yet, see `sentence` for why.

pctOfNormal.description: SWE as a percent of the station's 1991–2020 median for today's date in the water year.

elevationFt.description: Station elevation in feet. Measurements describe this elevation, not the resort's summit.

sweIn.description: Snow water equivalent at the station, inches.

stationFedCount.description: Resorts whose latest report is a SNOTEL reading (the pool).

title: Percent of normal
